column1: # Test: Steep-turn reversal (tight bands). Swing hard right to +200 tenths
#       then a full reversal to -200 tenths
# Physics: slew rate is ~20 tenths per 100ms loop (200 deg x10 / sec). Once at a
#       non-railed target the wheel bang-bang oscillates ~+/-10 around it
#       +/-20 band reliably captures the settled value.
#   - +200 -> -200 is 400 tenths => settled by ~t=3200 (2100ms after command).
# Must be settled at the right lock (~+200) by t=1100
# Full 400-tenth reversal must be settled at ~-200 by t=3200.
